evidence.quote: Authenticate to the API with an API key using the header `DD-API-KEY`
Requests that write data require reporting access and require an `API key`. Requests that read data require full access and also require an `application key`.
Use the `access_token` to make calls to Datadog API endpoints by sending it in as a part of the authorization header of your request
Your org must have at least one API key, and up to 50 API keys by default.
The Datadog MCP Server acts as a bridge between your observability data in Datadog and any AI agents that support the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
To create an API key, navigate to Organization Settings and select the API Keys tab, then click New Key

result.notes: Datadog offers a permanent free tier (up to 5 hosts, 1-day retention) with self-serve org signup; API keys and application keys are generated immediately in Organization Settings without approval. Core API auth is via DD-API-KEY/DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers (api_key-style), and Datadog separately supports full OAuth2 (authorization code + client credentials) for third-party apps, with resulting access tokens used as bearer tokens. REST API spans v1 and v2 with hundreds of documented endpoints across products (large breadth). Datadog publishes its own official, vendor-built MCP Server (GA as of ~March 2026) in addition to several community MCP servers on GitHub/registries.
result.one_liner: Datadog is a cloud observability and security platform (infrastructure/APM monitoring, logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting).
